profile: arm64 development profile (packaging/README.md#architectures); not the supported amd64 profile, so the checklist's records stay unverified until amd64 passes too

host.machine: Lima VM (Apple Virtualization framework), 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 20 GB disk, no host folders mounted
host.package: cardea-kernel_0.1.0-2_arm64.deb built on the host with dpkg-buildpackage from a clean stage of main 6ba6e21 (no AppleDouble files, dpkg -V clean)
host.kit: /opt/cardea at 6ba6e21 (uv sync --locked plus the #72 .pth step); the kit's workers file, proxy, registry, coding file and env.try toolchain image
host.scripts: experiments/debian-acceptance at main 6ba6e21 with this branch's script fixes; the evidence 'commit' field is null because the root-owned source tree is not readable to git as cardea-kernel

results.run: M2 host fit (host_fit.py in the guest after vm.py start's provisioning: marker, cardea-fit account, pinned bubblewrap)
ADR-028 probes (test_confined_debian.py as cardea-kernel through the packaged helper)
groups.py (all tests, before the t3/t4 script fixes)
results.result: t5 and t10 pass (8/8); t3/t4 failed on script bugs since fixed

results.run: groups.py --tests 4 on a package rebuilt from main a904610 (#81: only progress renews a claim, migration m19)

results.result: not run: its first step is a real send and the host has no email configuration yet
not run: needs a Claude subscription token

confinement: 64 MiB worker OOM-killed (worker_memory_limit); task, CPU (throttled), wall-time, stdout and scratch limits hold; a detached descendant dies with its unit
network none: every connect PermissionError, 127.0.0.1 included; DNS fails
allow-list: direct connects time out; through the proxy the listed host gets CONNECT 200, an unlisted one 403
coding proxy: PyPI over TLS only; another host, plain HTTP, another port and 127.0.0.1 refused
ADR-028 loopback fence: from a coding worker 127.0.0.1 is unreachable (TimeoutError), the per-call tool endpoint on 127.0.11.1 answers (401 without its token)
workers see none of the store, /var/lib/cardea-host, helper configuration, /etc/cardea, /home, /root

gates against the worker (#71): /proc/<worker>/fd/1 write and /proc/<worker>/mem read both PermissionError; a detached setsid child is killed; a gate that kills the worker yields outcome_unknown and stores nothing; a gate editing the checkout is refused with gate_changed_checkout
env.try hostile scenario: credentials, DNS, disk fill, helper spool, kernel loopback, metadata address, store and an unlisted host all fail

long call: 20 lease renewals over 1205 s; a 9 MiB bundle in 10 parts of at most 1 MiB, read back by digest, kept across backup, restore and verify; a SIGKILLed service's worker is reaped with its tree, the call is outcome_unknown and not restarted; a 10.3 MiB artifact stores nothing; timeouts above the profile or 7200 s are refused

product.#70: packaging: a stage copied from macOS shipped AppleDouble ._* files; cardea init failed on every store (Alembic loaded ._m1_001.py)
product.#74: packaging: the stage recorded debian/__pycache__, which dh_clean deletes, so the manifest check refused main's stage
product.#72: kit: the kit venv lacks cardea and workers run python -I, so every kit worker failed with No module named 'cardea'
product.#73: service: a start-up error after the runtime launched exited 1 with no log line
product.#76: coding: code.session decoded git diff --text strictly; a change with non-UTF-8 bytes lost its whole result as worker_error
product.#77: env.try: make try-toolchain ran mmdebstrap --mode=root in the host namespace, leaving / and /run private; systemd then gave no unit its LoadCredential file, so every credentialed confined worker failed until a reboot (and the weekly timer would repeat it)
product.#78: confined: the helper refuses with host_mount_propagation when / or /run is not shared; a missing credential source becomes credential_not_loaded

scripts: stack.registry passed an empty handler map (operation_handler_missing)
development tokens were signed with the OIDC-bearing config
tasks the scripts read back lacked tasks.inspect (task_grant_denied)
a SystemExit was lost from the evidence
long_call counted objects by a missing column
gate_isolation could not clone the root-owned fixture as the kernel user (git ownership check)
groups t3 lacked groups.manage; t4 used non-standalone claims with records.claim; t4 looked for the lapse mail under the wrong kind

host_notes: No arm64- or Lima-specific deviation from the scripts' expectations was observed.
The coding profile's LoadCredential needs /etc/cardea/credentials/claude-code; the plain-command harnesses never read it, so a placeholder stood in for each run and was removed after.
resolved_findings: The open ADR-034 test 4 finding (a failing holder kept its claim 410-436 s on a 300 s lease because every follow-up attempt renewed it) is fixed by #81 (a904610): an attempt after a failed one no longer extends the claim. Rerun on the host with that package: 7/7.
